name: re-benchmark against AI infographics
x-status: proposed instance; see commission-an-infographic for the form gap.
trigger: The engine, themes, fonts or rubric changed; a new NotebookLM or Gemini infographic of the same subject exists; or a quarter has passed. Meet-then-beat: the benchmark is whatever the best available AI infographic of the subject currently is.

steps.name: Collect samples
steps.action: rclone copy (read only) from gdrive:561 Group/Media/gemini-notebook/*/infographic/ and gdrive:media/notebooklm/ into an untrusted scratch directory; record sha256 and Drive ids.

steps.name: Audit samples
steps.who: a reviewer, human or model, named in manifest.judgment
steps.action: Fill audit fields from looking at each PNG. State that no OCR was used if none was.

steps.name: Compare
steps.check: comparison.json written; every ours/benchmark item present

steps.name: Write the assessment
steps.action: State where we win and where we do not, from comparison.json, with no composite across audited and measured values.

steps.name: Record debt
steps.action: Open a system-debt record for each criterion where the benchmark wins and a fix is possible.

checks: benchmark PNG hashes match the manifest
assessment names at least one area where the benchmark wins
rollback: The comparison is an observation; withdraw it by recording a superseding comparison. Scratch copies are deleted; Drive sources are never modified.
